entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game portrait expression sheet, landscape 1536x1200. EXACT 3 equal columns x 2 equal rows edge-to-edge, no gutters, no borders no text. Same character in SIX chest-up portraits reading order NORMAL, ANGRY, SAD, SMILE, SHOCK, CONCERNED. Clearly distinct facial expressions, identical identity costume props scale and pose within sheet. Entire head with margin in each cell. Refined mature anime JRPG illustration, fine crisp ink and soft painted shading, subtle Chinese paper texture, smooth NOT pixels, natural skin no yellow cast. Song dynasty China. Reference for ART TECHNIQUE ONLY, do not copy face hairstyle outfit or pose; faithfully invent specified unique character anatomy. Background muted pale blue Chinese paper. Subject: Chinese elderly woman age 72, white hair in high practical bun with plain wooden pin, narrow wrinkled face, hooded knowing eyes, small pursed lips, wry skeptical personality, slightly stooped, plain muted purple robe ivory collar, hands clasped low. No jewelry, no regal costume. Colour direction: reduce the yellow/sepia cast ON THE PERSON by approximately 15% relative to reference. Neutral daylight, natural peach/rose or neutral brown skin, neutral whites and true clothing hues. Do not desaturate or lighten natural dark skin. Keep BACKGROUND the exact established muted pale yellow Chinese paper for Stars, or muted blue paper for non-Stars. Never apply global sepia grading.
